name: dwynens_elite_the_token_is_your_elf
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, if you control another Elf, create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.' Seat 0 controls an Elf Druid; the first Dwynen's Elite enters and makes an Elf Warrior. The Druid and that Elite then leave, so seat 0's only Elf is the token. A second Dwynen's Elite enters: the token is an Elf seat 0 controls, so a second token is made (it would not be if the first token were another player's or no Elf).
